description: CloudWatch Security Metric-Filter Alerting Absent or Recognized Security Filters Unlinked
rationale: When regional read-only inventory is complete, no CloudWatch Logs metric filters or no actionable metric alarms, or known security filters with no linked, action-enabled metric alarm, indicate missing local CloudWatch security-event alerting. Unknown API results, noncanonical filter patterns and metric-math alarms require manual review. Organization-wide EventBridge, third-party SIEM or centralized monitoring may provide equivalent coverage.
remediation: Configure or demonstrate equivalent monitoring for unauthorized API calls, root-account activity and security control changes. Validate end-to-end notification delivery. If using external SIEM, EventBridge or a centralized account, record evidence and document the exception.
